open_points.subject: answer_request JSON-text bound measurement
open_points.text: Each JSON text the message carries as a string is measured on its own by canonical_bytes, so the message around it adds no depth to it.
open_points.other_text: A text whose canonical form outgrows a bound it met as received is not refused here: the module that judges the value measures its canonical bytes, as start_run refuses a run input whose canonical bytes exceed the stored value ceiling.
open_points.question: Must answer_request measure each JSON text's bound using canonical_bytes and refuse an oversized canonical form, or measure the received UTF-8 text and allow its canonical form to exceed that bound?
